result.description: Graph database platform (self-managed and Aura cloud) queried with Cypher; offers Aura management API and HTTP Query API.
result.auth_detail: Aura management API: OAuth2 client-credentials (client ID/secret via Basic to /oauth/token, returns 1h Bearer token). Query API (per-database HTTP): Basic (db user/password) or Bearer (SSO/OIDC token on Enterprise/Aura SSO). Official MCP supports Basic and Bearer.
result.access_detail: Free AuraDB signup; Neo4j Community Edition free to self-host. Docs say all tiers can create Aura API credentials (a secondary docs version mentions billing info needed for Free/Professional - inconsistent). Query API works on any instance with DB user creds.
result.api_notes: Two REST surfaces: Aura API (api.neo4j.io: instances, snapshots, projects/tenants, etc.) and Query API (HTTP Cypher execution + transactions against a database). Bolt drivers also exist but are not REST. Per-user DB URL means connection config (host) is user-specific, which complicates a generic toolkit; Cypher gives a broad data surface.

evidence.quote: The Aura API uses OAuth 2.0 for API authentication.
All tiers can create Aura API credentials.
The Query API allows to execute Cypher statements against a Neo4j server through HTTP requests.
The base URL for the Aura API is `https://api.neo4j.io`.
Neo4j MCP gives AI assistants and LLM-powered tools direct, structured access to your Neo4j graph database.
